`requirements.md` has been generated and saved to `.sdlc/runs/20261104-210415-docs-catalog-model-tsdoc/requirements.md`.

### Summary of Requirements Analysis
- **Scope**: 45 undocumented exports across 15 source files in `packages/catalog-model/src/`, plus the regenerated API reports (`report.api.md` and `report-alpha.api.md`) and one `patch` changeset (`.changeset/*catalog-model-tsdoc*.md`).
- **Functional Requirements (FR-1 – FR-17)**:
  - **FR-1 – FR-8**: One FR per kind file (`Api`, `Component`, `Domain`, `Group`, `Location`, `Resource`, `System`, `User` in `src/kinds/<Kind>EntityV1alpha1.ts`) covering `apiVersion` (noting both `backstage.io/v1alpha1` and `backstage.io/v1beta1`), `kind`, and `spec` (including required vs. optional subfields and schema nuances).
  - **FR-9**: `src/entity/conditions.ts` covering the 8 kind type guards (`isApiEntity` .. `isUserEntity`), noting that at runtime they perform a case-insensitive check on `entity.kind` only (`entity.kind.toUpperCase() === '<KIND>'`) without checking `apiVersion` or `spec`.
  - **FR-10**: `src/validation/KubernetesValidatorFunctions.ts` covering the 8 static validator methods and their exact prefix/suffix, length, and character-set rules (including empty-string acceptance in `isValidLabelValue` and `isValidAnnotationValue`, DNS label rules in `isValidNamespace`, and object-name rules in `isValidObjectName` / `isValidLabelKey` / `isValidAnnotationKey`).
  - **FR-11 – FR-15**: One FR per entity policy (`DefaultNamespaceEntityPolicy`, `FieldFormatEntityPolicy`, `GroupDefaultParentEntityPolicy`, `NoForeignRootFieldsEntityPolicy`, `SchemaValidEntityPolicy`), specifying exact validation/mutation semantics, return values (new merged object vs. in-place mutation vs. untouched entity), and thrown error conditions.
  - **FR-16 – FR-17**: Regeneration of `report.api.md` and `report-alpha.api.md` via `yarn build:api-reports` only, and creation of the adopter-facing `patch` changeset.
